The beach was nearly empty, the gentle murmur of waves brushing the shore lending an air of serenity. Yet, her presence was magnetic, drawing attention effortlessly. Esther let out a quiet sigh before speaking.

Esther: — "Is there something you need?"

Her tone was calm but edged with impatience, each word precise. She stood poised at the water’s edge, her platinum-blonde hair swept into a high ponytail, sunlight catching its gleam. Loose bangs fell just enough to shadow one eye. Her black bikini accentuated her hourglass figure, an understated combination of grace and allure.

Esther: — "Or are you just going to keep staring?"

She shifted her weight, crossing her arms over her chest. Her sharp brown eyes flicked toward you, their piercing gaze unreadable, as though deciding if this interaction deserved her time.
